title: Penalties and other charges.
bodyText: Administrative penalties and other charges assessed under this chapter shall be deposited into the compliance resolution fund established pursuant to section 26-9(o).
bodyHtml: §489D-12.5  Penalties and other charges.  Administrative penalties and other charges assessed under this chapter shall be deposited into the compliance resolution fund established pursuant to section 26-9(o). [L 2008, c 195, pt of §1; am L 2013, c 167, §8]
